 Print Bigg Boss 20 has been churning out interesting episodes and viewers are enjoying watching the rivalries between the contestants. While the BB 20 housemates entertain throughout the week, audiences eagerly wait for Weekend Ka Vaar to see their favourite host Salman Khan . However, filmmaker Rohit Shetty will take over the hosting duties in Salman's absence. During the recent Weekend Ka Vaar episode, Salman revealed that he will not be hosting the upcoming Weekend Ka Vaar because he is busy with prior commitments. He said, "Ab main aapse milunga agle hafte nahi. Due to a prior commitment, I will not be here agle hafte. So maine request kiya hai Rohit Shetty se for him to come here and to be the host for next Weekend Ka Vaar. (Now, I will not be meeting you next week. Due to a prior commitment, I will not be here next week. So, I have requested Rohit Shetty to come here and host the next Weekend Ka Vaar)." He added, "Joh bhi karna hai, to kar dijiye agar khatron se khelne ka shauk hai aap logon ko. So I will see you the week after next. (Do whatever you want to do, if you all enjoy playing with danger. I will see you the week after next). This is not the first time, Rohit Shetty is replacing Salman Khan to host an episode of the show. He had stepped into Salman's shoes in previous seasons also. He hosted WKV episodes last year as well during Bigg Boss 19 and had offered the show to Gaurav Khanna and Farrhana Bhatt. The news of Rohit Shetty replacing Salman Khan as a host for the upcoming week of Bigg Boss 20, has created a lot of curiosity amongst fans on social media. They are busy sharing their reactions on X related to the development. A user on X wrote, "Salman will never take Mahi's class, so makers had to bring in Rohit Shetty for that." A fan of the show, wrote, "If Rohit Shetty is coming next WKV. We should ask him to tell Qazi those which will improve his game and give him clarity, instead of blind praising." Another user commented, "Maybe Salman let Rohit to take their class, becoz Mahi is close to Salman." A netizen requested, "Rohit sir, bash Mahhi ji." For the uninitiated, the latest WKV episode saw Aman Gandhi getting eliminated from the show. Arishfa Khan and Uditi Singh broke down in tears after Salman Khan announced Aman Gandhi's name for elimination.
